bullets.text: Designed an impact-evaluation framework end-to-end (data ingestion, modelling and delivery) measuring whether transport schemes actually changed traffic behaviour, within a UK public-sector body under GDPR and data governance requirements.

Developed a Python pipeline processing four years of hourly traffic sensor data across Essex County for time-series modelling. Applied a causal inference model (synthetic difference-in-differences) with significance testing and sensitivity analysis to evaluate how council policies impact travel behaviour.
Translated requirements from non-technical stakeholders into reproducible, documented code and delivered with handover standards enabling the team to use the framework independently.
Acted as a technical bridge between the University of Essex and Essex County Council, translating academic research into a practical, production-ready tool

Partnered with transport officers to build an automated Difference-in-Differences framework with sensitivity testing, giving non-technical stakeholders a repeatable tool for measuring programme impact.
Researched and implemented state-of-the-art academic methodologies through a piloted, fully documented, reproducible analysis.
Aligned analysis with council priorities, translating statistical findings into evidence for policy and investment decisions.

Designed a scalable A/B testing framework and monitoring dashboard capable of running multiple concurrent and multi-treatment experiments across product features, pricing, search algorithms and machine learning models.
Defined and optimised shipping, packaging and service fees across the platform, achieving a ~3% increase in company contribution margin (PC3) over 2 years through continuous A/B testing.

Partnered with the marketing team to measure channel performance and optimise budget allocation, evaluating campaign effectiveness through A/B testing, statistical analysis and Difference-in-Differences.

Designed a Difference-in-Differences framework to estimate the impact of a loyalty-programme channel driving around 30% of daily orders, mitigating selection bias to deliver a robust valuation that informed leadership's strategic expansion decision.

Led a cross-functional team with a CRM specialist and product manager to support user acquisition and P&L optimisation for the loyalty club, driving a ~2% margin (PC3) increase through incentive optimisation and ML-driven retention strategies.

Built and deployed an end-to-end customer value prediction model (XGBoost, Scikit-learn) on 5M+ records, engineering 26+ features and shipping weekly batch inference through Apache Airflow into CRM campaign triggers, validated by A/B test at 10% lift in monthly purchase frequency.

Developed an internal CRM automation system integrating the company database, SMS API and voucher-creation API, enabling automated customer journeys with built-in A/B testing and full data tracking for campaign optimisation.
Developed a customer segmentation model based on user browsing activity, outperforming an initial RFM baseline by 3x in conversion rate.

Led CRM analytics strategy by defining KPI frameworks and roadmap, leveraging customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and channel performance optimisation to improve customer retention and engagement.

Engineered a scalable Python, SQL and Spark ETL pipeline orchestrated with Airflow, delivering 15+ business metrics with automated data-quality tests and supporting 1,000+ updates every five minutes, enabling non-technical teams to self-serve ~80% of BI needs.

Collaborated with the marketing team to understand data needs, gathering and preprocessing data from databases, APIs, Excel files, and web-crawling outputs into analytical tables and monitoring dashboards.
Built and maintained executive dashboards tracking core company KPIs and trends, giving leadership real-time visibility to support faster, data-driven decision-making.
Collaborated with marketing, product, and engineering teams to deliver analytics and data solutions that supported commercial decision-making and integrated into existing business workflows.
Developed backend features for enterprise technology solutions within a microservice-based architecture, using Java Spring Framework and PostgreSQL to build scalable, maintainable services.

bullets.text: - Built a classical NLP baseline model for product-review sentiment classification, implementing text preprocessing, feature extraction (Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF, Word2Vec), logistic regression training, cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning.

- Benchmarked five open-source LLMs on accuracy and inference cost, selecting FLAN-T5 as the best performance–cost trade-off, then evaluated three prompt-engineering techniques (zero-shot, few-shot and role prompting) to improve model performance.
- Evaluated the tuned LLM against the classical baseline (91.4% vs. 89.6% macro-F1) and compared both approaches against published state-of-the-art results for the task for more credibility.
- Deployed the selected model as a containerised inference API on AWS, using MLflow for experiment tracking, model versioning and model registry.
- Provisioned the infrastructure as code using Terraform (ECR, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch), with GitHub Actions automating tests, container builds and deployments.
- Instrumented monitoring through CloudWatch metrics and threshold-based alerting, logging inference inputs and outputs to support model and data drift monitoring.

- Automated a manual marketing compliance process by building an agentic workflow that searches external sources, classifies evidence and checks potential contract breaches, routing flagged cases to human reviewers.
- Orchestrated multi-step tool use and validation in LangChain, verifying each stage before passing its output downstream to reduce error propagation.

- Implemented RAG over a ChromaDB vector database using sentence-transformer embeddings to retrieve relevant contract clauses, ground breach decisions in source documents and provide citations, helping mitigate hallucination.
- Served the system through FastAPI and Gradio with human-in-the-loop approval gates, while running the LLM locally through Ollama to keep contract data in-house.

- Built an LLM-powered agentic workflow that translates natural-language business questions into executable SQL against a relational schema, enabling non-technical users to explore data without manually writing queries.
- Engineered schema-aware prompt templates with table-metadata retrieval, validation guardrails and retry-on-failure logic, checking generated SQL for syntax errors before database execution.
- Deployed the application on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure with a Streamlit interface supporting query results, generated visualisations and chatbot for follow-up questions.
- Designed an autonomous agent concept to automate the end-to-end ML workflow for tabular datasets, from problem framing to model selection.
- Architected the system around planner, executor, reflector, and memory modules to enable iterative self-correction across the pipeline.
- Reproduced and adapted a published GAN architecture to generate synthetic ECG signals, addressing data scarcity and privacy constraints that limit access to real clinical ECG data.

- Built an end-to-end PyTorch pipeline on the PhysioNet/CinC 2017 dataset — a BiLSTM generator vs. 1D-CNN discriminator, tuned to stabilise adversarial training — achieving an RMSE of 0.30 on held-out data.

- Developed an XGBoost model to identify high-value customers likely to increase purchase frequency after loyalty programme enrolment, engineering 26+ predictive features from 5M+ purchase records (SMOTE for class imbalance) to reach 83% accuracy / 76% F-beta.
- Validated ROI via A/B testing — a 10% lift in monthly purchase frequency vs. baseline — and automated weekly batch predictions and campaign triggers with Apache Airflow.

- Built return-prediction models for five S&P 500 assets to test how far short-term returns can be forecast from noisy market data, engineering moving-average, volatility, momentum, and market-wide features.

- Ran the full pipeline from preprocessing to hyperparameter tuning, benchmarking OLS, SVR, Random Forest, and LSTM, and identified key return drivers via OLS coefficient significance and Random Forest feature importance.

- Designed and built a scalable data pipeline on a feature-store-inspired architecture to consolidate KPIs fragmented across multiple source systems, isolating each metric in its own table for reuse across data science and BI teams.
- Delivered a maintainable single source of truth that eliminated conflicting KPI definitions and let new metrics be added without reworking existing pipelines.
- Replaced cost-per-order (CPO) — which ignored order cannibalisation and misaligned marketing and growth teams on budget decisions — with a new cost-per-incremental-order (CPIO) metric.

- Quantified each channel's cannibalised orders via causal inference and A/B testing across CRM, campaigns, and paid channels, aligning both teams on data-driven budget allocation and more efficient P&L management.
- Launched a new loyalty-programme marketing channel at SnappShop contributing ~30% of daily orders, but its true incremental uplift couldn't be measured via A/B test.

- Estimated causal uplift on high-volume, heterogeneous data using propensity score matching to build a strong common-support region, addressing selection bias and non-parallel trends and giving leadership a robust basis to optimise or scale the channel.

- Designed and implemented a scalable, statistically grounded A/B testing framework with prime-based user segmentation for parallel experiments, multi-treatment allocation, and a monitoring dashboard adopted across product, marketing, and data science teams.
- Led and analysed 20+ A/B tests over two years across pricing, incentives, and search, contributing to a 3% increase in company margin.
- Built a full-stack course-management app with authentication, role-based dashboards, and student registration workflows.
- Developed a RESTful Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend (MVC, JWT auth) paired with a responsive React frontend (Redux, Material UI) delivering role-specific experiences.
